Qwen3GuardTest
	

The Qwen3GuardTest dataset is a benchmark used in evaluating Qwen3Guard. Distinct from existing safety guardrails benchmarks, it focuses on two emerging and underexplored scenarios:

Safety classification of reasoning-model outputs: As model architectures increasingly incorporate explicit long reasoning process, safety evaluation must extend beyond final answers to the reasoning process itself.
